appraisal_events.evidence: « Gisèle était celle que nous fréquentions le moins, elle était de la bande si vous voulez, mais pas tout à fait. J'ai dû penser qu'elle était bien mal élevée et commune. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine dismisses Gisèle both socially (only marginally part of the band, the least frequented) and personally ("mal élevée et commune"), a single downward judgment delivered in reported recollection. The narration reports the verdict without endorsing or undercutting it.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah ! je n'ai aucun souvenir. » … puis, une fois relancée, une réponse minimale que le narrateur accueille par « Ah ! c'est tout ? »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's insistent questioning about Albertine's old "regard dur, rusé" yields first a blank denial and then a banal substitute answer; his closing "Ah ! c'est tout ?" stages the interrogation as unsatisfied, leaving him without the leverage he sought.

status_effects.explanation: Gisèle is flatly characterized as ill-bred and vulgar, the only evaluation of her the passage offers.
She is retroactively pushed to the edge of the little band: nominally of it, "mais pas tout à fait," and the least frequented.
He drives the exchange but extracts nothing; his final "Ah ! c'est tout ?" registers the failure of an inquiry he initiated.

ambiguities: The interlocutor is never named in the passage; the identification as Albertine rests on the Balbec setting, "la bande," and the address to Gisèle's friend — strong but inferential.

It is undetermined whether Albertine's "je n'ai aucun souvenir" and her subsequent judgment of Gisèle are sincere recollection or evasion; on a sincere reading E2 is not a deflection at all and the narrator's loss disappears.
